## Historical-search coverage

This evaluation used the source audit's frozen evidence (code 11d5994594fce53928a1d6f832b1deaa26e34160; tracker 46168442ee634afe78703ed3f42b9964aba7fa75) as the new-evidence baseline, then searched the current canonical tracker (2,266 exported records including this evaluation ticket) for prior decisions and outcomes.

Exact full-text searches and result counts: detected_by (6), bug trends (9), plan preflight (110), deterministic plan review (482), completion sidecar (190), gate economics (17), risk tier code review (134), large bug review (184), module size warning (119), janitor debt (3), OSS governance (16), outsider onboarding (4), provider resilience (11), force bypass (421), and reviewer provenance (93).

The counts are discovery coverage, not evidence weights. Broad matches were discarded unless the full ticket description, comments, relationships, or delivered outcome directly explained the recommendation. Full records inspected for the retained evidence included:

- Defect provenance: big-mammalian-bronco, evadible-ambitious-canary, cloned-beryl-quokka, commonlaw-cinnamonic-joey.
- Plan churn: elfin-floor-gouge, depleted-lethal-brownbear, papyral-scarlet-malamute, childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet.
- Completion outcomes: olivine-married-kodiakbear, chief-sizeable-skua, cinnamoned-tzarist-kangaroo, crumply-denim-pitbull, earthen-flayed-baboon, beryl-orange-oropendola, paralyzed-sane-flyingfox, depressant-amethyst-wasp.
- Review risk/calibration: oblivious-flaky-squamata, unrational-expansive-catfish, cosey-vinegarish-mouflon.
- Debt/janitor: cinderlike-lucky-akitainu, aberrant-sleeping-fanworms, ferreous-deadsmooth-dipper, civil-marlin-flare.
- OSS/autonomous governance: breaded-ammonitic-elephant, fat-leaflike-canary, nonsecular-arthritic-sidewinder, wrathful-preregal-blobfish, disparaged-gratuitous-rooster, defiant-orthoclase-buck, drossy-renderable-butterfly, heedless-caloric-pikeperch.

A separate independent subagent re-read the frozen code/tracker evidence and challenged the provisional dispositions. It confirmed the six directions with two corrections: the deterministic floor is now P1-P11, not P1-P8; and the source audit's preliminary bug counts should remain corrected to 39 regression / 208 unclassified. It also confirmed that human-review breadth is the wrong frame for this autonomous project.
